title: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter
publisher: Roblox Corporation via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Q2 bookings were USD 1.557 billion, Q3 bookings guidance was USD 1.576-1.653 billion, and Q3 free-cash-flow guidance was negative USD 60 million to positive USD 5 million.
summary: The unchanged SEC-filed Q2 letter confirms continued engagement and payer growth but weaker current monetization, withdrawal of annual guidance, sharply lower Q3 bookings guidance, higher AI and safety investment, and near-zero Q3 free-cash-flow guidance.
